scope.method: Opened actual four contact sheets containing all50 sampled rendered frames; opened four individual full-resolution outputs. Compared each frozen narration beat, number model and source role. Read source code read-only to identify normal-flow contain stacking.

blockingFindings.observation: Many contain photographs show only a heavily blurred fill image, sometimes with a lower strip of sharp image. They cannot perform their intended illustration role.
blockingFindings.readOnlyDiagnosis: Photograph renders blurred100percent-height CanvasImage and sharp100percent-height CanvasImage consecutively in normal flow. Foreground is pushed below first image inside overflow-hidden stage.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Place background and sharp foreground as overlapping positioned layers, then regenerate source-frozen new revision and inspect actual crop again. Parent already investigating/fixing; do not mutate r01.

additionalFindings.observation: r01 shows -2.78percent on e40 before narrated derivation in e41. Parent reported stage flag absent from stale process snapshot; verify new revision.

semanticLimits: Photographs are contextual illustrations only. They do not establish Hanh identity, shop economics, portion weights, wage changes or numerical inflation outcomes. Market/fuel/bakery images match broad actual visible subject, while several abstract clauses rely on narration rather than direct photographic evidence.
fontFindings: Headlines, visible labels and sampled captions retain Vietnamese marks. No overt headline overlap or cropped diacritic observed in the50 sampled frames. Some credits and illustrative notes are small at contact-sheet scale; individual graphics inspected remain readable at larger size.
arithmeticFindings: All inspected displayed numerical results are correct:20k→22k→22440; residual3k→2.5k;22k→20k is-9.09percent; basket4percent; real purchasing power-2.78percent;100g→90g unit-price+11.11percent.

perBeat.headline: Lạm phát giảm. Sao bánh chưa rẻ?
perBeat.narration: Ổ bánh mì tăng từ hai mươi lên hai mươi hai nghìn. Nghe tin lạm phát giảm, khách quay lại, giá vẫn cao. Chị Hạnh bán bánh cũng chẳng thấy mình giàu hơn. Vậy tiền đang mắc ở đâu?
perBeat.observations: Actual filled roll cross-section supports food context. No shown price evidence; hypothetical price is narration only. Opening title readable.
perBeat.diacritics: No obvious missing Vietnamese glyph or clipped diacritic observed at sampled resolution. Not a pixel-bound guarantee for unseen frames.
